title: Find merged work no release has claimed
statement: As a product manager, I can see merged work that is in no release, so nothing ships without being mentioned or sits forgotten on main.
overview: Proposed addition. Reviews, Plans and `___merges` already hold this chain, so nothing new is stored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release status --unclaimed` lists stories reached by reviews merged, or Plans delivered, in the release's range that no release links.
Each entry names the review or Plan that reached the story.
The list blocks nothing, and work that reached no story is reported as a count of merged reviews rather than as an error.
